recommendations text replaced by structured plan (metals step omitted by rule). No readings changed.

steps.title: Lower calcium hardness
actions: Partially drain and refill with fresh water.
notes: If you drain, refill promptly and skip the remaining steps unless there is algae, which must be treated first.
Don't drain if the water table is high.

steps.title: Raise alkalinity
actions: Add store-brand alkalinity increaser, **6 lb 13 oz** in total; never more than **9 lb** at once. Broadcast with the pump running.
waits: Wait 4 h between doses; retest after half the total.
Wait 4 h after the last dose.
notes: Not on the same day as calcium increaser.

steps.title: Lower pH
actions: Add muriatic acid **46 fl oz** in total (never more than **15 fl oz** at once), OR store-brand dry acid **3 lb 9 oz** (never more than **1 lb 2 oz** at once).
Add the acid to a clean bucket holding at least 1 gal of pool water, then pour it in with the pump running.
waits: Wait 4 h between doses; retest after half the total.
Wait 4 h after the last dose.
notes: Use one type of acid only, never both. Always add acid to water.

steps.title: Raise free chlorine
actions: Add one of: store-brand calcium hypochlorite shock (73%) **5 oz**, OR store-brand dichlor granules **6 oz**, OR liquid chlorine **32 fl oz**, with the pump running.
notes: Don't swim until FC is 2–4 ppm. Consider raising the salt generator output.

steps.title: Raise stabiliser (CYA)
actions: Add store-brand liquid stabiliser **1 gal 34 fl oz** into the skimmer with the pump running, OR store-brand granular stabiliser **3 lb 6 oz** in two halves: mix each half in a bucket of pool water and pour into the skimmer.
waits: Wait 2 h between halves; wait 2 h after.
notes: With the granular kind, don't clean the filter for 72 h. Retest after 24 h (liquid) or 72 h (granular).

steps.title: Raise salt
actions: Add pool salt **50 lb 10 oz** slowly around the pool edge with the pump running; brush the bottom.
waits: Wait 24 h for it to dissolve and circulate.
notes: Don't add salt if the water is below 60 °F.

weekly.note: Set the generator to hold this
only with heavy use, animals or debris
